### PennyMac Mortgage Investment Trust Reschedules Third Quarter 2026 Earnings Call to 6:30 PM ET on Thursday, October 29


October 23, 2026


- [Download (opens in new window)](https://s201.q4cdn.com/230652881/files/content_files/PMT-Reschedules-3Q26-Earnings-Call.pdf)


WESTLAKE VILLAGE, Calif.--(BUSINESS WIRE)--


PennyMac Mortgage Investment Trust (NYSE: PMT) will announce results for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, in a news release to be issued after the market close on Thursday, October 29, 2026. The conference call and live audio webcast is being rescheduled to 6:30 pm. Eastern Time from the originally scheduled 6:00 p.m. Eastern Time.


The release, webcast, and accompanying materials will be available online at[pmt.pennymac.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fpmt.pennymac.com%2F&esheet=54627966&newsitemid=20261023491366&lan=en-US&anchor=pmt.pennymac.com&index=1&md5=4430f7e7e9d0274e521c62453571ca8a) . A replay of the webcast will be available shortly after its conclusion.


Individuals who are unable to access the website but would like to receive a copy of the materials should contact our Investor Relations department at 818.224.7028.


**About PennyMac Mortgage Investment Trust**


PennyMac Mortgage Investment Trust is a mortgage real estate investment trust (REIT) that invests primarily in residential mortgage loans and mortgage-related assets. PMT is externally managed by PNMAC Capital Management, LLC, a wholly-owned subsidiary of PennyMac Financial Services, Inc. (NYSE: PFSI). Additional information about PennyMac Mortgage Investment Trust is available at[pmt.pennymac.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fpmt.pennymac.com%2F&esheet=54627966&newsitemid=20261023491366&lan=en-US&anchor=pmt.pennymac.com&index=2&md5=34692577c5bdf4b5d5e7cc5736b322d7) .
